Title: Buildings - Direction
Description: Proposed OSM direction tag, associated with buildings (parallel_to_street, perpendicular_to_street, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Levels
Description: Number of above-ground levels of a building

Title: Buildings - Levels underground
Description: Number of below-ground levels of a building

Title: Buildings - Height
Description: Describes the height of a building in meters

Title: Buildings - Slope
Description: Describes the slope of the building in relation to the ground in degrees

Title: Buildings - Date of Construction or Retrofit
Description: Proposed OSM age tag, associated with buildings (pre_2000, post_2000, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Condition
Description: Describes the condition of the building (good, average, poor, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Surroundings
Description: Describe the neighbouring condition of the building( attached, free_standing)

Title: Buildings - Geological site
Description: Describes the geological site the building is built upon (flat_land, river_bank, slopy_land, landslide_prone_area, flood_prone_area, river_bank)

Title: Buildings - Occupancy
Description: Describe the building purpose ( residential, commercial, public, mixed_use, industrial, agriculture, assembly, government, educational, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Capacity
Description: Describe the number of people a building can support

Title: Buildings - Shape of the Building Plan
Description: Proposed shape tag, associated with buildings (square, rectangular, l_shape, curved, triangular, polygonal, e_shape, h_shape, s_shape, t_shape, u_c_shape, x-shape, y-shape, irregular, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Structural Irregularity
Description: Proposed OSM irregularity tag, associated with buildings (regular, irregular, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Ground Floor Hydrodynamics
Description: Proposed OSM openings tag, associated with building ground floors (yes, no, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Ground Floor Height
Description: Proposed OSM height tag in meters, associated with building ground floors

Title: Buildings - Lateral Load-Resisting System
Description: Proposed lateral load resisting system of buildings (moment_frame, infilled_frame, braced_frame, post_beam, wall, dual_framewall, flat_slab, waffle_slab ,infill_flatslab, infill_waffleslab, hybrid, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Material of Exterior Walls
Description: Material for the exterior walls (concrete, glass, earth, masonry, metal, vegetation, wood, stucco, plastic, vinyl, cement, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Material of the Lateral Load-Resisting System
Description: Proposed lateral load resisting material tag (concrete_reinforced, concrete, concrete_steel, metal, masonary_reinforced, masonry, masonry_confined, earth, earth_reinforced, wood, other, unknown )

Title: Buildings - Openings
Description: Proposed OSM openings tag, associated with building walls (yes, no, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Roof shape
Description: Well known roof shapes (flat, pitched, monopitch, sawtooth, curved, complex_regular, complex_irregular, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Roof material
Description: Outer material for the building roof (masonry, earth, concrete, metal, wood, fabric, slate, stone, clay, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Floor material
Description: Material of the building floor (masonry, earth, concrete, metal, wood, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Foundation
Description: Proposed OSM foundation tag, associated with buildings (shallow, deep, unknown)

Title: Buildings - Fire Protection
Description: Information on a building's fire-resistance rating (yes, no, unknown)

Title: Transport - Road
Description: Main key used for identifying any kind of road, street or path. The value of the key helps indicate the importance of the highway within the road network as a whole

Title: Transport - Motorway
Description: Restricted access major divided highway, normally with 2 or more running lanes plus emergency hard shoulder. Equivalent to the Freeway, Autobahn, etc

Title: Transport - Trunk
Description: Most important roads in a country's system that aren't motorways (need not necessarily be a divided highway)

Title: Transport - Primary road
Description: Next most important roads in a country's system (often link large towns) A major highway linking large towns, in developed countries normally with 2 lanes

Title: Transport - Secondary road
Description: Next most important roads in a country's system (often link towns)

Title: Transport - Tertiary road
Description: Next most important roads in a country's system (often link smaller towns and villages)

Title: Transport - Unclassified road
Description: Least most important through roads in a country's system – i.e. minor roads of a lower classification than tertiary, but which serve a purpose other than access to properties. Often link villages and hamlets

Title: Transport - Residential road
Description: Roads that serve as an access to housing, without function of connecting settlements. Often lined with housing

Title: Transport - Service road
Description: Access roads to, or within an industrial estate, camp site, business park, car park etc

Title: Transport - Railway
Description: Main key used for all forms of transport using metal rails, including mainline services, subways, heritage lines and trams

Title: Transport - Light Rail
Description: Higher-standard tram system, normally in its own right-of-way. Often it connects towns and thus reaches a considerable length (tens of kilometers)

Title: Transport - Monorail
Description: Railway with only a single rail. A monorail can run above the rail such as in Las Vegas and Disneyland or can suspend below the rail such as the Wuppertal Schwebebahn (Germany)

Title: Transport - Rail
Description: Full sized passenger or freight trains in the standard gauge for the country or state

Title: Transport - Subway
Description: City passenger underground rail service running mostly grade separated

Title: Transport - Tram
Description: One or two carriage rail vehicles, usually sharing motor road

Title: Transport - Bridge
Description: When a road, railway, path canal, pipeline or similar is leading over a bridge

Title: Transport - Bridge Material
Description: Main material of construction: general material (concrete, masonry, steel, iron, wood, mixed) and detailed material

Title: Transport - Bridge Structure
Description: Describes the load-bearing architecture of individual bridge spans (arch, beam, truss, floating, suspension, cable-stayed, simple-suspension, humpback)

Title: Transport - Bridge Deck Characteristics
Description: Include the width, length and height of the deck in meters

Title: Transport - Bridge Deck structural system
Description: Indicate the position of the abutments and piers which support a bridge from beneath (pier, abutment, lift_pier, pivot_pier)

Title: Transport - Bridge Pier to deck connection
Description: Proposed OSM pier connection tag, associated with bridges (value options: not_isolated, isolated, unknown)

Title: Transport - Bridge Pier to Superstructure Connection
Description: Proposed OSM pier superstructure tag, associated with bridges (value options: single-column, multi-column, unknown)

Title: Transport - Bridge Number of Piers
Description: Proposed OSM total piers tag, associated with bridges (number of piers

Title: Transport - Bridge Shape of Section of the Pier
Description: Proposed OSM pier shape tag, associated with bridges (cylindrical, rectangular, oblong, wall-type, unknown)

Title: Transport - Bridge Height of the Pier
Description: Proposed OSM pier height tag, associated with bridges (height in meters)

Title: Transport - Bridge Span
Description: Proposed OSM pier span tag, associated with bridges (single, multi-span, unknown)

Title: Transport - Bridge Connections to the Abutments
Description: Proposed OSM abutment connection tag, associated with bridges (free, monolithic, isolated, unknown)

Title: Transport - Bridge Configuration
Description: Proposed OSM bridge configuration tag, associated with bridges (regular, semi_regular,  irregular, unknown)

Title: Transport - Bridge Level of Seismicity
Description: Proposed OSM bridge seismicity tag, associated with bridges (no_design, designed, unknown)

Title: Pipeline
Description: A major pipeline carrying gas, water, oil, etc.

Title: Pipeline - Content
Description: The substance transported within the pipeline. If the medium is not known, do NOT specify this tag

Title: Pipeline - Position
Description: The location of the pipeline (underground, overground, overhead, underwater

Title: Pipeline - Material
Description: The material transported by the pipeline

Title: Pipeline - Joint Type
Description: This is the proposed joint tag, associated with pipelines

Title: Pipeline - Soil Type
Description: The material key is used to specify soil, in conjunction with the type key when specifying the kind of soil

Title: Pipeline - Diameter
Description: Specifies the nominal diameter of the pipeline, in millimeters

Title: Storage tank
Description: Storage tanks are containers that hold liquids, compressed gases (gas tank) or mediums used for short- or long-term storage.

Title: Storage tank - Position
Description: The location of the storage tank

Title: Storage tank - Height
Description: Height in meters

Title: Storage tank - Material
Description: Main material the storage tank is made of

Title: Storage tank - Anchorage
Description: Proposed OSM anchored key, associated with storage tanks (yes, no, unknown)

Title: Storage tank - Shape
Description: The shape can be determined by the height-to-diameter ratio

Title: Storage tank - Content
Description: What the storage tank typically holds

Title: Power grid - Substation
Description: Place dedicated to step-up or step-down the voltage=* within an electrical power grid, generally linked to the rest of the electrical network by one or more sets of power=lines and which may contains one or more power=transformers

Title: Power grid - Transmission
Description: Substation whose main function is to connect and switch transmission lines transmitting power between areas

Title: Power grid - Transformer
Description: Static device that converts a given power voltage to another power voltage. Usually located within a substation

Title: Power grid - Voltage
Description: The highest voltage of operation within the facility

Title: Power grid - Anchorage
Description: Proposed OSM anchored key, associated with storage tanks (yes, no, unknown)

Title: Power grid - Code Provisions
Description: Proposed OSM provision code key, associated with storage tanks (none, low, moderate, high, unknown)

Title: Power grid - Tower
Description: For big towers or pylons carrying electricity cables. Normally constructed from steel latticework and carry high voltage electricity cables

Title: Power grid - Tower material
Description: Default value is steel (steel, wood, concrete, aluminium, composite)

Title: Power grid - Tower structure
Description: Default value for steel towers is lattice (lattice, tubular, solid)

Title: Power grid - Tower height
Description: Height in meter of the tower

Title: Power grid - Power line
Description: High-voltage power lines used for power transmission, supported by towers/pylons, or in some places or situations, by poles

Title: Power grid - Power line voltage
Description: Voltage at which the line is operated (operating voltage)

Title: Power grid - Power line operator
Description: Name of the company which operates this power line section (cable operator)

Title: Power grid - Power line cables number
Description: Number of different phase conductors for this power line section (number of cables)

Title: Power grid - Power line circuits number
Description: Number of different and separated electrical circuits built within this power line section (number of circuits)

Title: Power grid - Power plant
Description: An industrial facility for the generation of energy

Title: Power grid - Power plant Energy Source
Description: The source of the energy generated by a power plant (oil, geothermal, nuclear, hydroelectric, wind, solar, tidal wave, gas, biomass)

Title: Power grid - Power plant Capacity
Description: Power plants can output multiple forms of energy (yes / x W / x kW / x MW / x GW)

Title: Agriculture - Farmland area
Description: Area of farmland used for tillage and pasture (animals, vegetables, flowers, fruit growing)

Title: Agriculture - Farmland crop type
Description: The crop produced by cultivated land

Title: Agriculture - Farmland animal produce
Description: Where the whole live animal is produced/sold

Title: Natural environment - Forest
Description: Forest or woodland is an area covered by trees

Title: Natural environment - Closed Forest
Description: Area covered by trees

Title: Natural environment - Woodland
Description: Area covered by trees

Title: Natural environment - Scrub
Description: Plant community characterized by vegetation dominated by shrubs (bush), often also including grasses, herbs, and geophytes

Title: Natural environment - Dwarf-scrub and Related Communities
Description: A dwarf-shrub habitat, characterized by open, low growing woody vegetation, often dominated by heather plants

Title: Natural environment - Herbaceous Vegetation
Description: Tall graminoid vegetation, medium tall grassland, short grassland, forb vegetation or hydromorphic fresh-water vegetation

Title: Socio-economic indicator - Economy
Description: Measures the welfare and social security levels of communities

Title: Socio-economic indicator - Education
Description: Provides information about invested resources and expected outcome of education, access and participation to education

Title: Socio-economic indicator - Environment
Description: Defines the underlying conditions that make an environment susceptible to damage, disaster experience and prevalence

Title: Socio-economic indicator - Governance and Institutional Capacity
Description: Institutional performance and regulatory efficiency, corruption control and stability of political system

Title: Socio-economic indicator - Health
Description: Population health conditions and health sector capabilities

Title: Socio-economic indicator - Index
Description: Range of indexes that cover different sectors, for example, the Disaster Risk Index used by the United Nation Development programme to monitor the global evolution of risk

Title: Socio-economic indicator - Infrastructure
Description: Transportation and communication infrastructure, status and access to utility lifelines

Title: Socio-economic indicator - Population
Description: Defines community demographics: structure, distribution and size
